title: Blades Drawn in the Tempest — Part 5

series.summary: Out on the rain-lashed deck, Kurapika unholsters his twin wooden swords while Leorio flicks open a switchblade. As lightning flashes and their blades prepare to clash, a monstrous rogue wave breaks the rigging and hurls a young deckhand into the churning sea. Without hesitation, Gon leaps completely off the ship into mid-air, risking his life to grab the falling sailor.

segments.voiceover_text: Torrential rain batters the open deck as two furious rivals square off. Neither man is willing to yield, and lightning illuminates the raging sea.
Leorio snaps open a gleaming switchblade. Kurapika unholsters his twin wooden swords. Their eyes burn with deadly intent as they prepare to strike.
Before their blades collide, disaster strikes. A monstrous wave snaps the heavy rigging, hurling a young deckhand helplessly toward the churning ocean.
Without hesitation, Gon sprints and hurls himself into the open abyss to catch the crewman, but both are plummeting toward the lethal sea with no lifeline in sight.
